notes: Sourced from QSC's official product page (qsys.com), the official CX-Q 4-channel datasheet PDF, and the official CX-Q/CX-Qn User Manual (TD-001586-01-B), all cross-consistent. Rear panel per official manual Figure 1: 2x RJ-45 (LAN A/B, Q-LAN Gigabit Ethernet - eth-1g grade inferred from "standard gigabit Ethernet protocols and hardware" spec, not explicitly labeled 1G on port), 4x 3-pin Euroblock mic/line inputs (12V phantom, balanced/unbalanced), 2x 8-pin Euroblock speaker output connectors covering channels A/B and C/D (listed here as 4 logical channel ports per common convention), 1x 16-pin Euroblock GPIO connector (8 bidirectional GPIO channels), and a locking IEC C-14 power inlet. No AES/EBU digital audio input on this model - all digital audio arrives via Q-LAN network only; analog Euroblock mic/line inputs are the only local audio ports. This is the CX-Q 8K4 (4-channel, 8000W) variant, distinct from the 8-channel CX-Q 4K8/8K8 models (which have 8 inputs/8 outputs) and from the CX-Qn variants (network-only, no analog inputs). Output connector pin/channel mapping: physically two 8-pin Euroblock headers each serve two channels (A+B on one, C+D on the other) but ports are listed per logical channel since each channel is an independently wired speaker output in Q-SYS Designer.
